name: Caltrop Toss
description: Scatter caltrops over the enemy front row: for 3 turns every enemy standing there takes 0.5× Pierce at the start of its turn.

effects.note: a field trap on the targeted row: each enemy in it takes multiplier × Attack at its turn start for duration turns

mastery.text: Also Slow 1 turn on each tick.

effects.note: each tick of this skill’s field trap also applies the status
